name: browsecli
description: Reach any site from a Blaxel sandbox via a Verified Browserbase browser — residential IP, no datacenter blocking, auto CAPTCHA-solve.
longDescription: The BrowseCLI sandbox ships Node.js 20 and the unified Browserbase `browse` CLI. Unlike hub/chromium and hub/playwright-chromium, which run a headless browser inside the sandbox over CDP, this template runs NO browser locally: the `browse` CLI connects OUT over CDP to a Verified Browserbase browser that uses a residential/verified IP (no datacenter-IP blocking), passes bot-detection fingerprinting in Verified browser mode, and auto-solves CAPTCHAs and challenges server-side. That means a Blaxel sandbox can reach anti-bot- and CAPTCHA-walled sites the stock in-sandbox Chromium gets blocked on. Set BROWSERBASE_API_KEY and BROWSERBASE_PROJECT_ID, then run /app/browsecli-demo.sh to open a Cloudflare-protected page and assert real content. Built on Debian slim (glibc) with the Blaxel sandbox API on port 8080.
